Runner COMPLETE alone is insufficient. The archived outer receipts must prove actual wait0, child PID/start/source binding, no timeout/orphan cleanup/signals, observed absent/zombie quiescence, and exclusive flock acquisition/release after actual child exit.
Actual outer detached launch and controller identity are bound to the expected outer source/manifest, output, host/Unix UID and honestly root-attested Pod/STS identities.

Final outer COMPLETE and readback-verified single-file/single-chunk persistence pointer are created after this archive. They remain optional external inputs, and final_outer_completion_and_YT_persistence_checked stays false when absent.

When external receipts are supplied, both are required and bound to the exact raw archive and sole recorded persistence path. This validates recorded receipts, not a live YT readback or new outer PID observation.
No archive means SOURCE_ONLY and actual_scientific_results_verified=false; actual-only arguments without an archive are refused.
